title: Quantifying the Intrusiveness of Retrofitting Retrieval-Augmented Generation onto Legacy Software Systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.23931v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Enterprises increasingly add retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to existing REST and monolithic systems, usually by writing an ad hoc HTTP call into a handler, and have no way to quantify how intrusive that choice is. We present (1) a taxonomy of three retrofit patterns, sidecar, SDK-embed and naive-invasive; (2) the Legacy Intrusion Score (LIS), three code sub-metrics (churn, breadth, coupling), and an extension, LIS-X, with three operational sub-metrics measured on a live system (run-time overhead, fault propagation and silent feature degradation); (3) a static evaluation on five legacy systems, two of them real open-source codebases fetched from their repositories at pinned commits; and (4) a live case study that deploys all three patterns as separate OS processes. translated_title: 量化将检索增强生成为遗留软件系统进行改造式集成时的侵入性
translated_abstract: 企业越来越倾向于在现有的 REST 和单体系统中加入检索增强生成（RAG），通常是在处理程序中临时编写一个 HTTP 调用，但无法量化这种选择的侵入程度。我们提出了：（1）三种改造模式的分类法——边车模式、SDK 嵌入和朴素侵入式；（2）遗留系统侵入度评分（Legacy Intrusion Score, LIS），包含三个代码子指标（代码变更度、影响广度、耦合度），以及其扩展版本 LIS-X，后者包含三个在真实运行系统上测量的运维子指标（运行时开销、故障传播和静默功能退化）；（3）对五个遗留系统的静态评估，其中两个是从代码仓库固定提交点获取的真实开源代码库；（4）一个将三种模式作为独立操作系统进程部署的实际案例研究。代码层面的排序 sidecar < SDK 嵌入 < 朴素侵入式在所有五个系统以及 2,000 次随机权重分配下均成立，而这一排序源于各分量指标上的支配关系……
tldr: 该论文提出了三种 RAG 改造模式的分类法以及量化侵入度的 LIS 与 LIS-X 评分体系，并通过静态评估与真实部署案例验证了侵入性排序：边车模式 < SDK 嵌入 < 朴素侵入式。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a taxonomy of three RAG retrofit patterns and the Legacy Intrusion Score (LIS/LIS-X) to quantify intrusiveness, validating the consistent ranking sidecar < SDK-embed < naive-invasive through static evaluation and a live case study.
